captions.caption: Dashboard after seeding the fictional week: four upcoming sessions, allergens flagged on the Okafor booking, and the booking link.
Okafor grocery list: garlic combined from two dishes (4 + 3 = 7 cloves) and ticked off; the tick survived a page reload.
Mail server down: the meal-plan send fails, the banner says it wasn’t sent and offers Download PDF or Try again. Nothing is marked sent.
Mail server restored: “Try again” sends the meal plan; the toast says the mail server accepted it (Platebook can’t confirm inbox delivery).
Mail server rejects the recipient: the invoice stays Draft, nothing is marked sent, and the banner offers Download PDF or Try again.
After the mail server accepts it, the invoice moves to Sent ($326.40 total).
Same account on a server with no SMTP settings: the send is refused with a plain explanation and the PDF alternative; nothing is recorded as sent.
Sign-in link requested on a server without email: the page says no link was sent and suggests the password instead (same answer for every address).
Sign-in link requested on a server with email: “we’ve asked the mail server to send it” — no claim of delivery, same answer for unknown addresses.
Session page at 375 px wide (browser emulation, not a physical phone).
